Instant Pot Fail
First time I used the IP today. Tried to make some vegetarian Tikka Masala and did it the way I'd do it in a normal pot. So I sauted onions and garlic first, then added in the rest of the stuff and put on pressure cook for 5 minutes. Well, I could hear the IP heating up but after a bit it just stopped and I got a "Food burn" error. Fair enough, I didn't deglaze. Rookie mistake.

So I scraped the burnt food off and tried again. This time there was actually pressure and the countdown started - for 2 minutes, then again the same error.

I got annoyed. So I tried the steam function. Same error.

Removed all the food, and had a look at the bottom of the inner pot. Turns out AFTER I deglazed food must have burnt again, and it was a thick layer of burnt stuff. Absolute nightmare to clean.

Now the inner pot is scratched from cleaning the burnt stuff, I am annoyed and discouraged, and I'm thinking of getting rid of it.

What am I doing wrong?
